description: Enforced field set and enums for a host-neutral, evidence-bound source-convergence record. Single source read by scripts/validate_source_convergence.py; the prose source-convergence-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (at least two distinct source_refs; strengthens_claim true requires INDEPENDENT convergence; SHARED_ORIGIN requires a shared_origin_ref; no VERIFIED assurance) stay in the validator. Adapts FRR v0.4's independence test for apparent agreement across sources.
